widgets.comments: Current beat, filtered by osc-filter-module.js to one message per beat. onValue measures the time between consecutive beats and stores the length of a beat in "beat-period".
Length of a beat in seconds, set by the "beat" variable. Local only (bypass), never sent.
What the right column lists and the faders show: "project" or "device". Set by the "Project" button and by tapping a device (or "Track"). Local only (bypass), never sent.
Toggled by the "Track" button: 1 shows the track params and param pages before the device ones, 0 shows only the device ones. Local only (bypass), never sent.

Which param strips are visible: {project, track, device: [8 booleans each]}, and which param page lists are shown: lists: {project, track, device}. With "Project" selected only the project params are shown; otherwise the track params (when "Track" is on) followed by the device params, skipping the device params when the selected device is the track itself. Params without a name are skipped and only the first 8 are shown.

widgets.label: ^stop
widgets.onValue:
var isPlay = get('play');
if (isPlay === 0) send(undefined, '/time', {type: 'i', value: 0});

widgets.comments: Lights one block per beat. A strip in the current beat's block grows over one beat (measured time between beats, see the "beat" variable); hidden while stopped.
Param strip template. Variables: n (param 1-8), color, kind ("track" or "device"). Visible when "param-strips" says so.
Rendered with display:contents so its buttons share one flex column with the other list: all visible buttons get the same height, capped by max-height.

widgets.label: Project
widgets.comments: Lists the project param pages and shows the project params on the faders. Local only (bypass), never sent.

widgets.label: Track
widgets.comments: Toggles the track params (and param pages) before the device ones. In project mode it goes back to the device params with the track params on. Local only (bypass), never sent.
Rendered with display:contents so its buttons share one flex column with the other list: all visible buttons get the same height, capped by max-height.
